name: Hino Azusa
source:
A boyish and handsome, beautiful lady. She is a lesbian and a misandrist. Attracted to Arika, Azusa begins to try and "steal" Arika from Jun.

[Translated from her [URL=http://www.elle-murakami.com/murakami/01/m27/m27.html]official website profile[/URL].]
